from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u071/system/state/workspace/programs/task-46b76271.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
s='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # The patterned shapes use the colors outside the noisy background palette.
    color = max((2, 3, 4, 5, 8), key=lambda c: counts[c])
    return [[color] * 3 for _ in range(3)]
'''
p.write_text(s)
exec(compile(s,str(p),'exec'))
print(transform(grid))
